questionnaire.publisher: Tracy Jensen via Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club
questionnaire.title: Alameda Mayor - Tracy Jensen.docx, answers 8 and 9
questionnaire.retrieval: Google Drive connector text extraction; re-read candidate answers directly.
questionnaire.quoted_excerpt: I persuaded two of my colleagues that a letter would be ineffective and the gesture would further divide Alameda.

before.summary: Opposed a Gaza ceasefire letter as ineffective and divisive; says she worked on eliminating investments in all weapons rather than an Israel-specific BDS policy.
before.date_note: Drive upload metadata dates the general questionnaire file, not the actual response. Response date is not stated.

after.summary: Says she opposed a White House letter against the Gaza war as ineffective and divisive, without calling it a ceasefire letter or dating it; says she pursued excluding all weapons investments rather than Israel-specific BDS.
after.date_note: Drive upload metadata dates the general questionnaire file, not the actual response. Response date is not stated.

decisions.reason: The source describes opposition to sending an anti-war letter, not opposition to a ceasefire itself; it does not identify the proposal as the January 2024 letter or date it. Preserve the independent CAIR tracker support record.

evidence.identity_basis: Questionnaire explicitly names Tracy Jensen, Alameda mayor candidate.
evidence.date_basis: Keep the upload metadata date and existing response-date qualification; no event chronology inferred.
evidence.issue_basis: Answers 8 and 9 distinguish objection to municipal letter-writing from support for excluding weapons investments. Do not infer opposition to a ceasefire as a policy goal.
